sentence_stem: Had she known about the delay,
correct_completion: she would have caught an earlier train.
full_sentence: Had she known about the delay, she would have caught an earlier train.
acceptable_variants: she would have left the station sooner.
she might have taken an earlier train.

options.text: she catches an earlier train every morning.
options.why_wrong: The present habitual tense ignores the past hypothetical created by the inverted 'Had' clause.

options.text: she would have caught an earlier train.
she caught an earlier train because of the delay.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a real cause, but the stem requires an unreal past result after 'Had'.

options.text: she will catch an earlier train tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: A future time reference does not match the past conditional meaning set by the inverted 'Had' clause.

explanation: The inverted 'Had + subject + past participle' replaces 'If', so the main clause needs 'would have + past participle' to express an unreal past situation.
translation: ስለ መዘግየቱ ቀድማ ብታውቅ ኖሮ ቀደም ያለ ባቡር ትይዝ ነበር።
